name: Internationalization (i18n)
description: Centralized i18n architecture mapping all UI strings to `lib/i18n/vi.json` to eliminate hardcoded text, allowing for scalable language localization without logic modification.
evidence: Refactored components, pages, and metadata to use the `useI18n` hook and `t` translation function, mapped all strings in `vi.json`. Verified with pnpm lint, typecheck, build.
